newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Lloyds lowered at Panmure.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lloyds lowered at Panmure.

text.p: LLoyds TSB Plc was lowered to "sell" from "hold" at Panmure Gordon, dealers said on Monday.
"We have been holders of the stock but we think it is looking expensive," said Panmure analyst David Poutney.

Shares in Lloyds reached a record 510p in early trading before retreating, to be up 3-1/2p at 507 by 1055 GMT. On Friday the stock closed 1-1/2p higher after the banking group posted a 52 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 2.5 billion stg.

The Lex column in Saturday's Financial Times said Lloyds looked fully valued but was well underpinned by the company's strong cash generation -- supporting strong dividend growth, possible future acquisitions and further share buybacks.
